short_desc.ja: 電気・ガス・水道の即時停止を脅し緊急支払い要求
short_desc.en: Threaten immediate utility shutoff to demand urgent payment

cultural_lever.ja: 生活必需サービスへの依存・停止への恐怖
cultural_lever.en: Dependence on essential services and fear of disconnection

scenario.ja: 1) 電力会社を名乗る電話 2) 料金未納の虚偽通知 3) 1時間以内の停止脅迫 4) 即時支払い指示
scenario.en: 1) Call posing as utility company 2) False unpaid bill claim 3) Threaten shutoff within hour 4) Demand immediate payment

references.label: FTC: Scammers Pretend To Be Your Utility Company
references.quote: They threaten to shut off your gas, electric, or water service if you don't pay them immediately. These scammers want to scare you into paying before you have time to confirm what they're telling you.

verification.note: 'threat to shut off your gas/electric/water' is pretext, 'pay them immediately' is demand
